title: Ownership fails at the first question
summary: The first questions of grief already loosen the claim of ownership. Let grief loosen the ownership it cannot keep.
takeaway: Let grief loosen the ownership it cannot keep.
lifeApplication: When you tighten around what is yours, ask the first honest question: whose was it finally?
